name: Shiina Rin
source:
The only daughter of a noble Japanese family with a long history. Unlike other students, she is a foreign student. She'll return to her country in two months.
Due to her shy nature, she has no other students or sisters at the school with whom she is particularly close, with the exception of Sister Christa. Rin likes to sing a song she learned from her.
